pixel_description: Photorealistic outdoor view of white panel insulated chamber on galvanized steel skid with horizontal perimeter beams and 6 vertical screw-jack legs on footplates holding box off dirt. Single rectangular P-box with seams/rivets, front opening fully exposed. Front left is one large white hinged insulated door swung open ~90 deg with handle and hinges; above opening is separate flat white rain canopy propped horizontal. Inside left and right are tall metal slatted racks, 5 tiers each, holding ~20 small grey vented plastic crates full of green/red produce, leaving central aisle clear to rear wall. Critical part DC cooler 1kW: ONE wall-mounted rectangular evaporator unit centered high on rear interior wall, round black fan grille on left front face, finned side vents, small control box on right side with black cable loop to wall, white vertical pipe dropping from unit to floor with horizontal run to wall drain fitting that continues outside as white drain pipe on right side down to ground. Roof array: tilted dark-blue photovoltaic panels on silver aluminium rails/legs above box roof, 2 rows overhanging slightly, with thick black conduits looping down right exterior wall into grey metal cabinets - one small top junction, one large middle vented cabinet, two small lower boxes with vents/display - then to drain. Connections: box bolted to skid beams, array on rails to box roof, racks standing on box floor, crates sitting on racks, cooler screwed to box wall with air into room and condensate to drain, door hinged to box front frame, electrical conduits array to cabinets. No text or arrows overlaid.

Same parts, same mechanical/electrical/thermal/air connections, same relative layout and orientations as sketch.
s2_feedback: No design flaw visible. Side electrical cabinets are clear of door swing, roof array on rails clears roof, interior cooler fan has clear blow path down central aisle to crates, and condensate/white drain runs clear through wall to ground without interference or impossible load path.
